product_metadata.title: Brita Large Water Filter Pitcher for Tap and Drinking Water with 1 Elite Filter, Reduces 99% of Lead, Lasts 6 Months, 10-Cup Capacity, BPA Free, Black
features: This BPA-free Everyday water pitcher is easy to fill, fits in most fridges and can hold 10 cups of water, enough to fill 3 24-ounce reusable water bottles.
This space efficient Brita pitcher fits perfectly on refrigerator shelves, features an easy-fill locking lid and is easy to pour; Height 10.47"; Width 5.59"; Length/Depth 10.94"; Weight 2.29 pounds.
Get great tasting water without the waste; by switching to Brita Longlast, you can save money and replace 1,800 single-use plastic water bottles a year.

Reduce 99% lead, Chlorine (taste and odor), Cadmium, Mercury, Benzene, Asbestos, and more, while an electronic indicator makes filter reminders effortless , while a sticker indicator makes filter reminders effortless.
Longlast filters are compatible with all Brita pitchers and dispensers except Stream; replace the Brita Longlast water filter 2x a year (about every 6 months).
description: Drink healthier*, great tasting tap water with this BPA free Brita 10 cup water pitcher and the included Brita Longlast+ filter. Longlast+ replacement filters are made with pleated filter technology for 3x longer life compared to 40 gallon filters. They reduce 99% of lead and are certified to reduce chlorine (taste and odor), asbestos, mercury, benzene, cadmium, and more*. One Longlast+ filter can replace up to 900 16.9 oz plastic bottles and reduces more contaminants vs. PUR and ZeroWater (based on NSF/WQA certifications for Brita OB06, PUR PPF951K, and ZeroWater ZF-201 pitcher filters as of 10/15/20). The Brita water pitcher’s flip top lid makes refilling a breeze and just a glance at the sticker filter indicator lets you know when it is time to change the Brita replacement filter. This large water pitcher comes with 1 Longlast+ Water Filter, which should be changed every 120 gallons or about 6 months* for best results. Start drinking healthier*, great tasting water with Brita today. *Certified to reduce cadmium, mercury, and lead. Substances reduced may not be in all users’ water. See certifications. No bottles to throw away. 16.9 oz bottle. Approximate timing based on average family usage and 120-gallon filter life.
